'''2003 Wisconsin State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship in Wisconsin (7 June 2003). [[Michael Raveling]] won it and a bye into Day 2 of the [[2003 World Championship]].<ref name="pcf-1291-28951">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=28951#28951 2003 Minnesota SW:CCG State Championship Weekend], Nick Kolnik, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (9 June 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040318152912/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=1291%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS5]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Site:''' Wisconsin
* '''Dates:''' 7 June 2003<ref name="pc-us03">[https://web.archive.org/web/20040622065452/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/Events/2003/usevents.htm State Championships (US Events)], swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 22 June 2004.</ref>
* '''Venue:''' Misty Mountain, Madison, Wisconsin<ref name="pc-us03" />
* '''Time:''' 12pm<ref name="pc-us03" />
* '''Fee:''' $10<ref name="pc-us03" />
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Christian Kriesel]]<ref name="pc-us03" />
* '''Day 2 qualifier:''' [[Michael Raveling]]<ref name="pc-us03" />

== Results ==

33 players took part: 16 from Minnesota, 11 from Wisconsin and 6 from Illinois. Minnesota players took 6 of the top 7 places, and 3 of the top 4. After six games of Swiss, Raveling was 1st as the only undefeated player and [[Corey Faherty]] of Wisconsin 2nd. Faherty agreed with Raveling, who had already beaten him in the Swiss, to decline the Final Confrontation, which gave Raveling the championship outright.<ref name="pcf-1291-28951" />

{| class="wikitable"
! Place !! Player
|-
| 1st || [[Michael Raveling]]<ref name="pcf-1291-28951" />
|-
| 2nd || [[Corey Faherty]]<ref name="pcf-1291-28951" />
|}

The prize support was 4 trophies, 13 boxes of cards (468 packs), 2 tournament shirts, 12 tournament foils, 7 gift certificates and more than 20 assorted foils.<ref name="pcf-1291-28951" /> The glass trophies for the top four, with the Players Committee logo and the place engraved, were ordered by [[Nick Kolnik]] together with those for the [[2003 Minnesota State Championship|Minnesota State Championship]].<ref name="pcf-1291-25251">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=25251#25251 2003 Minnesota SW:CCG State Championship Weekend], Nick Kolnik, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (7 May 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040318152912/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=1291%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>
